claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan space uniforms self-repair and harden rapidly against impacts, debris, and bullets.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She also says the suits can cushion falls.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan suits regulate temperature and use either circulating coolant or magnetic frequencies for cooling.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She describes a transparent helmet with a compact recycled-air pack for breathing.
